ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominantly low-intensity (black/dark gray) with localized high-intensity (white) regions at the distal tips and sparse speckling. Ratio estimated at approximately 85% low-intensity to 15% high-intensity.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous black mass across the central and inner lobe areas. Distinct high-intensity white patches are mapped to the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right lobes. Sparse, discrete white pixel clusters (mottling) are distributed across the outer thirds of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression at the center. The angle is approximately 65 degrees with significant depth relative to the adjacent lobe curvature.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous jagged boundary with high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations across the entire trailing edge. Complexity and amplitude of peaks increase significantly at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curve fitted to the trailing edges, sweeping upward and outward from the median notch toward the pointed tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple small, roughly circular high-contrast white pixel clusters distributed near the trailing edge and distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, vertical light-colored linear marks are visible on the mid-section of the left lobe (viewer left), breaking the solid dark pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular, thickened edge texture and concentrated white scarring at both distal tips, consistent with localized trauma or barnacle colonization.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly symmetrical distribution of high-intensity white pigmentation restricted primarily to the outer distal extremities.
